gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 99.—It is hereby notified that the following thoroughfares will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Road commencing at its junction with Waterloo Road opposite Soares Avenue running in an easterly direction for a distance of approximately 600 yards as shown coloured red on Plan No. R.K. 534. English Name: PUI CHING ROAD. Chinese Name: 培正道.

No. 99.—It is hereby notified that the following thoroughfares will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Extension of Nairn Road in a south-westerly direction for a distance of approximately 930 yards terminating at the footbridge across the Kowloon Canton Railway as shown coloured burnt sienna on Plan No. R.K. 534. English Name: NAIRN ROAD. Chinese Name: 楠道.

history.submitter_remarks: No geojson centreline for Nairn Road / 楠道 (abolished or renamed).

gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 99.—It is hereby notified that the following thoroughfares will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Road commencing at the south end of Nairn Road and running in a south-easterly direction parallel to the Kowloon Canton Railway for a distance of approximately 335 yards as shown coloured yellow on Plan No. R.K. 534. English Name: CHI MAN ROAD. Chinese Name: 治民道.

history.submitter_remarks: Gazette name Chi Man Road / 治民道; geojson has Chi Man Street / 治民街 only — not linked.
